name: Verdant Buckler
text:
This large wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is alive with creeping vines and mossy growths that shift in the air almost imperceptibly.

Activate—Grasping Vines f (concentrate, plant)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You use the verdant buckler to Shield Block a melee Strike

---
Effect The attacking creature must succeed at a DC 24 Reflex save save or be Grabbed by the shield's animated vines (Restrained on a critical failure). The affected creature is grappled or restrained for 1 round, until it Escapes, or you move, whichever comes first.
